title: 學華語向前走 2A — Lesson 2
description: Vocabulary from lesson 2 of the textbook 學華語向前走 (Let's Learn Mandarin) 2A, with original example sentences written for young beginners (Traditional characters).

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de wàigōng hěn gāo.
exampleSentences.english: My maternal grandfather is very tall.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè shì wǒ de wàigōng.
exampleSentences.english: This is my maternal grandfather.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 週末我跟外公一起去公園。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhōumò wǒ gēn wàigōng yìqǐ qù gōngyuán.
exampleSentences.english: On the weekend, Grandpa (Mum's dad) and I go to the park together.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wàigōng jiāo wǒ xiě zì.
exampleSentences.english: Grandpa (Mum's dad) teaches me to write characters.

exampleSentences.pinyin: yǐqián wǒ bù huì xiě zì.
exampleSentences.english: Before, I couldn't write characters.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhège wánjù yǐqián shì wǒ de.
exampleSentences.english: This toy used to be mine.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 以前我不敢下水，現在敢了。
exampleSentences.pinyin: yǐqián wǒ bù gǎn xiàshuǐ, xiànzài gǎn le.
exampleSentences.english: I used to be scared to go into the water, but now I'm not.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 以前我的書包很重，現在輕多了。
exampleSentences.pinyin: yǐqián wǒ de shūbāo hěn zhòng, xiànzài qīng duō le.
exampleSentences.english: My school bag used to be very heavy, but now it's much lighter.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè shì wǒ de wàipó.
exampleSentences.english: This is my maternal grandmother.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wàipó zuò de cài hěn hǎochī.
exampleSentences.english: Grandma's cooking is very delicious.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhōumò wǒ qù wàipó jiā chīfàn.
exampleSentences.english: On the weekend I go to Grandma's house for dinner.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 週末外婆陪我去海灘玩。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhōumò wàipó péi wǒ qù hǎitān wán.
exampleSentences.english: On the weekend Grandma takes me to the beach to play.

exampleSentences.pinyin: bàba zài zuòshēngyì.
exampleSentences.english: Dad is doing business.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wàigōng yǐqián zuòshēngyì.
exampleSentences.english: Grandpa used to be in business.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我長大以後想做生意，賣冰淇淋。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ zhǎngdà yǐhòu xiǎng zuòshēngyì, mài bīngqílín.
exampleSentences.english: When I grow up I want to do business and sell ice cream.

exampleSentences.pinyin: shūshu zuòshēngyì, mài shuǐguǒ.
exampleSentences.english: Uncle is in business, selling fruit.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ kěyǐ bāng wǒ ma?
exampleSentences.english: Can you help me?

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ bāng māma xǐ wǎn.
exampleSentences.english: I help Mum wash the dishes.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ bāng bàba xǐ chē.
exampleSentences.english: I help Dad wash the car.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ bāng wǒ jiǎn qiú, hǎo bu hǎo?
exampleSentences.english: Can you help me pick up the ball, OK?

exampleSentences.pinyin: tā shì yīshēng.
exampleSentences.english: He is a doctor.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de āyí shì yīshēng.
exampleSentences.english: My aunt is a doctor.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我跟玩具熊玩醫生遊戲。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ gēn wánjùxióng wán yīshēng yóuxì.
exampleSentences.english: I play doctor with my teddy bear.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我感冒了，醫生說要多喝水。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ gǎnmào le, yīshēng shuō yào duō hē shuǐ.
exampleSentences.english: I have a cold, and the doctor says to drink lots of water.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ bàba de gōngzuò shì shénme?
exampleSentences.english: What is your dad's job?

exampleSentences.pinyin: shūshu de gōngzuò shì kāi xiàochē.
exampleSentences.english: Uncle's job is driving the school bus.

exampleSentences.pinyin: māma gōngzuò le yì tiān, hěn lèi.
exampleSentences.english: Mum has worked all day and is very tired.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 週末爸爸不工作，我們去海灘玩。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhōumò bàba bù gōngzuò, wǒmen qù hǎitān wán.
exampleSentences.english: On the weekend Dad doesn't work, so we go to the beach.

exampleSentences.pinyin: yínháng zài nǎlǐ?
exampleSentences.english: Where is the bank?

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen qù yínháng.
exampleSentences.english: We go to the bank.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ bǎ língyòngqián cún zài yínháng.
exampleSentences.english: I save my pocket money in the bank.

exampleSentences.pinyin: xiàochē jīngguò yínháng.
exampleSentences.english: The school bus goes past the bank.

words.definition: same, like, the same as, just like

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de shūbāo gēn nǐ de yíyàng.
exampleSentences.english: My school bag is the same as yours.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ gēn nǐ yíyàng gāo.
exampleSentences.english: I am as tall as you.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我跟你一樣喜歡踢足球。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ gēn nǐ yíyàng xǐhuan tī zúqiú.
exampleSentences.english: I like playing soccer just like you.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我的帽子跟妹妹的一樣。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de màozi gēn mèimei de yíyàng.
exampleSentences.english: My hat is the same as my little sister's.

exampleSentences.pinyin: tā zài diànnǎogōngsī gōngzuò.
exampleSentences.english: He works at a computer company.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 電腦公司在那棟大樓裡。
exampleSentences.pinyin: diànnǎogōngsī zài nà dòng dàlóu lǐ.
exampleSentences.english: The computer company is in that big building.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我想去爸爸的電腦公司看看。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng qù bàba de diànnǎogōngsī kànkan.
exampleSentences.english: I want to go and have a look at Dad's computer company.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 爸爸的朋友在一家電腦公司工作。
exampleSentences.pinyin: bàba de péngyou zài yì jiā diànnǎogōngsī gōngzuò.
exampleSentences.english: Dad's friend works at a computer company.

words.definition: to go to work, to start work

exampleSentences.hanzi: 爸爸每天早上七點上班。
exampleSentences.pinyin: bàba měitiān zǎoshang qī diǎn shàngbān.
exampleSentences.english: Dad goes to work at seven every morning.

exampleSentences.pinyin: māma jīntiān bú shàngbān.
exampleSentences.english: Mum doesn't go to work today.

exampleSentences.pinyin: bàba shàngbān, wǒ qù shàngxué.
exampleSentences.english: Dad goes to work and I go to school.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 週六爸爸不上班，我們去踢足球。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhōuliù bàba bú shàngbān, wǒmen qù tī zúqiú.
exampleSentences.english: On Saturday Dad doesn't go to work, so we go and play soccer.

exampleSentences.pinyin: yǐhòu shàngkè yào rènzhēn tīng.
exampleSentences.english: From now on, listen carefully in class.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我們以後再一起去公園吧。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen yǐhòu zài yìqǐ qù gōngyuán ba.
exampleSentences.english: Let's go to the park together another time.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 吃完晚飯以後，我們去公園玩。
exampleSentences.pinyin: chīwán wǎnfàn yǐhòu, wǒmen qù gōngyuán wán.
exampleSentences.english: After dinner, we go and play at the park.

exampleSentences.pinyin: yǐhòu wǒ zuò xiàochē huí jiā.
exampleSentences.english: From now on I will take the school bus home.
